title: CECRI Notification 2026 - Walk-in-Interview for 27 Apprenticeship Posts
description: Central Electrochemical Research Institute (CECRI) has issued the official notification for 2026. To fill the vacancies for 27 Trade Apprentice, Technician Apprentice, and Graduate Apprentice Jobs. Candidates who have completed their ITI, B.E/ B.Tech, or Diploma in Civil Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or Electronics and Communication Engineering can apply for the CECRI Notification 2026 . Here we mentioned more details about the age limit, selection process, salary structure, education ...
